```python
import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Load the dataset
iris = pd.read_csv('data/iris.csv')

# Set the style of seaborn
sns.set(style='whitegrid')

# Create a pairplot to visualize the relationships between the features
pairplot = sns.pairplot(iris, hue='species', markers=["o", "s", "D"],
                        plot_kws={'alpha': 0.7, 's': 80, 'edgecolor': 'k'})

# Add title and adjust layout
pairplot.fig.suptitle("Pairplot of Iris Dataset", y=1.02)
pairplot.set(xlabel='Feature Value', ylabel='Feature Value')

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
```
